get_model_from_hparams: get a PyTorch model instance from ModelHparams with weight and batchnorm initializers applied
load_saved_model: load a saved model from disk at a given save location and step using the platform loader
check_model_exists: check if a saved model file exists at a given save location and step
get_default_hparams_for_model: get the default hyperparameters for a registered model name like cifar_resnet or imagenet_resnet
freeze_model_parameters: freeze batchnorm, output, or other model parameters based on ModelHparams frozen flags and exceptions
